fed.lastMove: On October 28, 2026 the Fed held its target rate at 3.75–4%, after raising it in September. Two of the twelve voting members wanted another 0.25% increase.
fed.outlook: With inflation still elevated and the economy growing strongly, the Fed says it will wait for more information before its next move. Markets expect a 0.25% increase in December.

forecasts.note: Raised sharply from September as inflation and bond yields climbed.
Expects rates to stay above 7% through 2027.

aboveForecastNote: Rates today are above these forecasts. Expect forecasters to raise them in their next updates.

scenarios.name: Fed raises in December
scenarios.explanation: The Fed raises again in December and signals more. Mortgage rates tend to drift up when that's expected: about +0.3% over six months.

scenarios.name: Fed holds steady
scenarios.explanation: The Fed holds through the winter. Rates stay close to where they are today, easing slightly as the pause becomes clear.

scenarios.name: Inflation cools
scenarios.explanation: Inflation falls faster than expected and bond yields ease. Rates move back toward 7%.
